about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Who I am
about.bio_1: I'm a passionate Fullstack Web Developer with years of experience building scalable, user-centric web applications. I specialize in React on the frontend and NodeJS/Django on the backend.
about.bio_2: I love turning complex problems into clean, intuitive interfaces. Whether architecting a REST API or crafting pixel-perfect UIs, I bring the same attention to detail to every layer of the stack.
about.bio_3: When I'm not coding, I'm exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, or sharing knowledge through my blog and courses.
